newsitem.title: USA: Utah Medical says Q1 hurt by competitors.
newsitem.headline: Utah Medical says Q1 hurt by competitors.

text.p: Utah Medical Products Inc said Thursday its first quarter sales were hurt by competitors it sees as infringing on patents.
It also said it was in a development deal with Phillips Plastics for a speculum and that it was testing distribution of a C.R. Bard Inc urinary incontinence system.
Utah Medical reported first quarter earnings of $0.12 a share on sales of $5.2 million, compared with $0.25 a share on sales of $9.7 million the previous first quarter.
The company said first quarter sales suffered because of the permanent decline in sales of disposable pressure transducers to Baxter International Inc.
Utha also cited the transient pipeline "unfilling" from changing two regional independent distributors to direct sales representatives.
Phillips Plastics Corp is an affiliate of Phillips Petroleum Co.
